description: Free, no sign-in. Use when someone asks whether a rented home in England needs a council licence (selective, additional or mandatory HMO), or what applies at its postcode. Returns licence.needed (yes, no or check) with a plain summary for the household type, each council scheme recorded for the postcode's ward with its dates, fee, exemptions and council sources, the planned landlord register window, flood zone and conservation area, and councilPage, Lettance's page for that council. Read-only. England only; a council we have not researched yet says so instead of guessing. A postcode is not an exact address, so pass on any note to confirm the boundary with the council. Information, not legal advice. This answers from the postcode and household type. For a decision on one exact property, run preflight_property (free) and then assess_property (10 prepaid credits), which checks the household and building facts against the reviewed scheme terms.

household.description: single: one household; small_hmo: 3-4 people from 2+ households; large_hmo: 5+ people from 2+ households

postcode.description: Full postcode of the rented property, not the user's own location, e.g. SE15 5BA
